tutorials.title: JavaScript Basics
tutorials.description: Learn the fundamentals of JavaScript programming
tutorials.content: JavaScript is a versatile programming language that powers interactive web applications. In this tutorial, you will learn about variables, data types, functions, loops, and conditionals.
tutorials.projectBrief: Build a small page with a tip calculator using only JavaScript. Put it on GitHub and send the link.

tutorials.title: React for Beginners
tutorials.description: Build interactive UIs with React framework
tutorials.content: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces with reusable components. Learn JSX, state management, hooks, and component lifecycle.
tutorials.projectBrief: Build a to-do list in React where you can add and remove items. Put it on GitHub and send the link.

tutorials.title: Python Fundamentals
tutorials.description: Master the basics of Python programming
tutorials.content: Python is a versatile language used in web development, data science, and automation. Learn syntax, data structures, functions, and object-oriented programming.
tutorials.projectBrief: Write a Python program that reads a list of marks and prints the average, highest and lowest. Put it on GitHub and send the link.
